en: Changed terminal and VS Code sessions moved to Sonnet 5 or 5.5 on Bedrock Mantle, Agent Platform and Foundry to start in auto mode if no mode is set; set `disableAutoMode` to `"disable"` to stop it
zh: 变更：在 Bedrock Mantle、Agent Platform 和 Foundry 上迁移到 Sonnet 5 或 5.5 的终端和 VS Code session，若未设置模式则以自动模式启动；将 `disableAutoMode` 设为 `"disable"` 可阻止此行为
